_comment: Every message the shadowing challenge sends. Placeholders in {curly braces} are filled in at send time; an unknown placeholder becomes empty. HTML is allowed (<b>, <i>).
join_not_in_group: You need to be a member of the group to join the challenge.
join_private_hint: 👉 Open a private chat with me and press Start — otherwise I can't receive your video or send you your ballot.
leave_ok: You've left the challenge. Send /join_challenge any time to come back.
leave_not_in: You're not in the challenge. Send /join_challenge to join.
start_new:
👋 Hi! This bot runs the American Accent Challenge.

Send /join_challenge to take part. Then send me your weekly shadowing video here, in this private chat.
start_member: 👋 You're in the challenge. Send me your shadowing video here any time from Monday until Thursday 12:00 GMT.
submit_ok: ✅ Got your shadowing video! You can send another one to replace it until Thursday's deadline.
submit_replaced: 🔄 Replaced your earlier entry with this new video.
submit_not_member: Send /join_challenge first to take part in the challenge — then send your video again.
submit_none_open: There's no shadowing video open right now. I'll post the next one on Monday.
submit_closed: This week's entries are closed — voting has started. Your next chance is Monday!
dm_unknown: Send me your shadowing as a video (or video message). Commands: /join_challenge, /vote, /myentry.
myentry_yes: ✅ I have your entry for this week.
myentry_no: I don't have an entry from you yet this week. Send your shadowing video here.
ballot: 🗳️ Vote for the best shadowing! Tap the video number you think is the best. Your vote is private. You can change it until voting closes on Sunday 15:47 GMT. (Your own video isn't listed.)
vote_ok: ✅ Vote recorded: Video {number}. You can change it until voting closes.
vote_not_member: Only challenge members can vote. Send /join_challenge first.
vote_bad_number: There's no Video with that number. Pick 1–{count}.
vote_own: You can't vote for your own video 😉 Pick another one.
vote_dm_only: Votes are private — send /vote to me in a private chat.
vote_no_ballot: I couldn't send you the ballot. Try /vote again in a private chat.
showcase_intro: 🎬 Shadowing showcase — vote time! {count} entries this week, shown anonymously below (Video 1 … Video {count}). 🗳️ I've sent every challenge member a private ballot with buttons. Voting closes Sunday 15:47 GMT.
showcase_dm_missing: 📩 {names} — I couldn't DM you your ballot. Open a private chat with me, press Start, then send /vote.
showcase_none: 🎬 No shadowing entries this week. Next video on Monday — send yours in a private chat with me! 🎤
showcase_one: 🎬 Only one entry this week, so there's nothing to vote on. Well done to whoever it was! Next video on Monday. 🎤
results_tiebreak: Tied on votes — the earliest submission takes the place.
results_none: 🏆 Voting is closed, but no votes came in this week. See you Monday! 🎤
results_footer: Congratulations! 👏 Thanks to everyone who took part.
winner_badge:
🏆 SHADOWING CHAMPION! 🎤

Congratulations {name}!

You won this week's shadowing vote — your American accent impressed the group most.

Click the button below to get a profile picture with your badge and wear it with pride!
